headline.title: 新西兰大选最终结果：执政联盟需小党支持才能组阁
headline.summary: 新西兰大选最终结果显示，现任总理拉克森领导的右翼联盟失去多数席位，需获得中间派新党“机会党”支持才能继续执政，否则可能再次大选。
headline.title_en: New Zealand election: final results show ruling coalition needs minor party to govern
headline.summary_en: Final election results show Prime Minister Christopher Luxon's rightwing coalition has lost its majority and needs support from the centrist Opportunity party to govern, or face another election.

headline.reason_en: Post-election coalition talks determine New Zealand's government and policy direction.
